lines.en: label church5:
scene churchglow1
A mysterious girl stands before a mysterious altar inside of a mysterious building in a mysterious part of town.
lines.zh: 一个神秘的女孩站在一座神秘的祭坛前，祭坛位于一栋神秘的建筑里，而建筑又坐落在城里一片神秘的区域。

lines.en: She was not waiting outside the same way she was the last time I came here, which I suppose means that today I am allowed to enter.
lines.zh: 她没有像我上次来时那样在外面等着，我想这意味着今天我获准进入。

lines.en: And, on the off chance that I am not, let {s}God{/s} god smite me with all of {s}His{/s} his wrath.
lines.zh: 而万一我并没有获准——那就让{s}上帝{/s}用{s}他{/s}全部的怒火劈死我吧。

lines.en: scene p1
scene p2
scene p3
scene p4
scene churchglow1
I feel something touch me, but not long enough for me to get accustomed to the sensation.
lines.zh: 我感觉到有什么东西碰了我，但时间太短，短到来不及让我习惯那种触感。

lines.en: Not long enough for me to fall in love with it and have dreams of growing old together.
lines.zh: 短到来不及让我爱上它，来不及做一起变老的梦。

lines.en: To have dreams of those celestial hands decaying with the passage of time.
lines.zh: 来不及梦见那双属于天国的手随时光腐朽。

lines.en: To watch the skin wrinkle and the veins protrude.
lines.zh: 来不及看着皮肤起皱、青筋凸起。

lines.en: One of my favorite things about older people is that it becomes easier to see the insides of their bodies without having to work for it.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢老年人的一点是，不用费劲就能更容易地看见他们身体内部的东西。

lines.en: Like their entire vascular system is laid out like a placemat, decorating wherever they may go with a display more beautiful than any work of art could ever possibly be.
lines.zh: 就像他们整个血管系统被摊开来当餐垫，走到哪儿就用一幅比任何艺术品都更美的陈列装点哪儿。

lines.en: Or hideous, depending on the way you look at things.
lines.zh: 或者丑陋无比，全看你从什么角度看。

lines.en: Let’s talk about perception for a moment.
lines.zh: 我们来聊聊“感知”吧。

lines.en: scene p1
scene p2
scene p3
scene p4
scene churchglow1
Let’s not talk about perception.
lines.zh: 还是别聊感知了。

lines.en: Let’s talk to Yasu instead.
lines.zh: 我们还是跟 Yasu 说话吧。

lines.en: : Blessed be those who give up their eyes.
lines.zh: : 舍弃双眼的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who give up their mouths.
lines.zh: : 舍弃嘴巴的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who give up their lives.
lines.zh: : 舍弃性命的人有福了。

lines.en: : Blessed be those who see in the dark.
lines.zh: : 在黑暗中看见的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who cut off their tongues.
lines.zh: : 割去舌头的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who sleep in the ark.
lines.zh: : 睡在方舟里的人有福了。

lines.en: : Come to me, Father. Come to me, Mother.
lines.zh: : 到我这里来吧，父。到我这里来吧，母。

lines.en: : Come to me sisters, and cousins, and brothers.
lines.zh: : 到我这里来吧，姐妹们、表亲们、兄弟们。

lines.en: : A life without light is a life left unlived.
lines.zh: : 没有光的一生，就是从未活过的一生。

lines.en: : A life filled with God is a life to forgive.
lines.zh: : 充满神的一生，是值得宽恕的一生。

lines.en: : Praise be.
lines.zh: : 赞美主。

lines.en: : {s}Praise be.{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}赞美主。{/s}

lines.en: I suppress a strange desire to cry out.
lines.zh: 我压下了一股想喊出声的奇怪冲动。

lines.en: The air in the room is cold and stale.
lines.zh: 房间里的空气又冷又陈。

lines.en: It smells of mold masked by scented candles, but the unlit kind that don’t carry with them the same level of warmth and comfort that the burning ones do.
lines.zh: 有股被香薰蜡烛盖住的霉味，但那是没点着的那种蜡烛，带不来点燃时那份温暖与安稳。

lines.en: As such, it’s not very pleasant.
lines.zh: 因此，这里并不怎么好闻。

lines.en: To disguise something unfavorable with something that {i}is{/i} favorable is akin to denial.
lines.zh: 用{i}讨人喜欢{/i}的东西去掩盖不讨人喜欢的东西，等同于否认。

lines.en: And denial makes us weak.
lines.zh: 而否认会让我们变得软弱。

lines.en: But it’s such a strong tool.
lines.zh: 但它又是如此好用的工具。

lines.en: Here is a list of other strong tools:
lines.zh: 下面是一份其他好用的工具清单：

lines.en: Hammer
lines.zh: 锤子

lines.en: Power Drill
lines.zh: 电钻

lines.en: Power Hammer (Probably not a thing, but it would be cool. Just think of how many nails you could drive in.)
lines.zh: 电锤（大概没这东西，不过要是有的话会很酷。想想看你能钉进去多少钉子。）

lines.en: Saw (Various types)
lines.zh: 锯子（各种类型）

lines.en: The pen (Artistic answer. Don’t actually use a pen in a fight. You will lose.)
lines.zh: 钢笔（偏艺术的答案。真打架可别用钢笔。你会输。）

lines.en: (Try using a Power Hammer™ instead)
lines.zh: （试试改用 Power Hammer™ 吧）

lines.en: And religion.
lines.zh: 还有宗教。

lines.en: Religion is actually the strongest tool out there.
lines.zh: 宗教其实是世上最好用的工具。

lines.en: Because not only can you use it to justify anything and everything you could possibly want, you can also use it as a scapegoat when things go wrong.
lines.zh: 因为你不仅能用它来为你想做的任何事、一切事开脱，出事时还能拿它当替罪羊。

lines.en: If God made you do it, is it really your fault?
lines.zh: 如果是上帝让你干的，那真的还是你的错吗？

lines.en: That phrase is so powerful that even those who stray from religion break it out from time to time.
lines.zh: 这句话的威力大到，就连那些远离宗教的人也会时不时把它搬出来用。

lines.en: And I’m not just talking about those same people who only pray when things get bad.
lines.zh: 我说的还不仅仅是那些只在倒霉时才祷告的人。

lines.en: But I guess, in a sense, those people are worth mentioning here as well.
lines.zh: 不过我想，从某种意义上说，那些人也值得一提。

lines.en: That’s how strong of a tool religion is.
lines.zh: 宗教就是这样好用的工具。

lines.en: Regardless, I don’t think it’s fair to compare Yasu’s religion to any of the commonly scapegoated ones as she, at least to my knowledge, is the sole follower of it.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，我觉得把 Yasu 的宗教和那些常被拿来当替罪羊的宗教相提并论并不公平，因为据我所知，她是它唯一的信徒。

lines.en: But I’m sure that won’t prevent her from using it as a tool to garner favor or dodge blame in the future.
lines.zh: 但我敢肯定，这不会妨碍她今后拿它当工具去博取好感或推卸责任。

lines.en: Thankfully, the future is a long way from here. But also on top of us at the same time.
lines.zh: 所幸未来离这儿还很远。可同时又已经压在我们头顶上了。

lines.en: It’s pinning us down by our shoulders and shifting our panties to the side, preparing itself to ruthlessly violate our perception of-
lines.zh: 它正按着我们的肩膀把我们压住，把我们的内裤拨到一边，准备无情地侵犯我们对——的感知。

lines.en: scene p1
scene p2
scene p3
scene p4
scene churchglow1
Let’s not talk about perception.
lines.zh: 还是别聊感知了。

lines.en: Let’s talk to Yasu instead.
lines.zh: 我们还是跟 Yasu 说话吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene churchglow2
: My, my...what a pleasant surprise.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，哎呀……真是令人愉快的惊喜。

lines.en: : To see another face inside of the church is nothing short of a dream come true for me.
lines.zh: : 能在教堂里看见另一张脸，对我而言简直就是美梦成真。

lines.en: : Did you bring the whip?
lines.zh: : 你把鞭子带来了吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: scene churchglow3
: A joke, of course. Violence is not something we take lightly here.
lines.zh: : 当然是玩笑。我们这儿可不把暴力当儿戏。

lines.en: scene churchglow2
: You are safe within these walls.
lines.zh: : 在这些墙内，你是安全的。

lines.en: : And even if it feels like everything is caving in, or that the floor wants to open up and swallow you whole, you will be okay.
lines.zh: : 就算你觉得一切都在坍塌，或者地板想要裂开把你整个吞下去，你也不会有事。

lines.en: : Only good things happen here.
lines.zh: : 这里只会发生好事。

lines.en: : This place is fucking weird, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 这地方真是怪得要死，Yasu。

lines.en: : Weird? How so?
lines.zh: : 怪？怎么怪？

lines.en: : What makes it any different than another place of worship?
lines.zh: : 它跟别的礼拜场所有什么不同吗？

lines.en: : We have candles, religious symbols, benches-
lines.zh: : 我们有蜡烛、宗教象征、长椅——

lines.en: scene churchglow4
: And now...people.
lines.zh: : 现在还有……人。

lines.en: : Oh, how wonderful it is to finally say that.
lines.zh: : 哦，能说出这句话，真是太美妙了。

lines.en: : Am I really the first person other than you who’s come in here?
lines.zh: : 除了你之外，我真的是第一个踏进这里的人？

lines.en: scene churchglow2
: To my knowledge, yes.
lines.zh: : 据我所知，是的。

lines.en: : Though I suppose it would technically be possible for others to wander in while I’m away at[school] or in my room.
lines.zh: : 不过严格来说，我去[school]或者回房间的时候，应该也可能有人晃进来。

lines.en: : I can’t be everywhere at once, of course. Omnipresence is a power of God and God alone.
lines.zh: : 我当然没法同时出现在所有地方。无所不在是神的力量，唯有神才有。

lines.en: : Though, I do hope to become an angel one day.
lines.zh: : 不过，我确实希望有朝一日能成为天使。

lines.en: : Don’t you need to just...die to become an angel? Isn’t that how it works?
lines.zh: : 当个天使不是只要……死掉就行了吗？不就是这么回事吗？

lines.en: scene churchglow5
: I’m sure there are some systems of belief that would say so. But things are a bit more complicated for people like me.
lines.zh: : 我相信有些信仰体系会这么说。不过对我们这种人来说，事情要更复杂一些。

lines.en: scene churchglow2
: Do you remember when we last spoke of the differences between boys and girls?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我们上次聊到男孩和女孩的区别吗？

lines.en: : When I informed you of the wondrous role you could have if only you’d sacrifice yourself?
lines.zh: : 那次我告诉过你，只要你愿意献出自己，就能拥有多么奇妙的角色？

lines.en: : What do you mean, “If only?” That’s a pretty big caveat, Yasu.
lines.zh: : “只要”是什么意思？这可是个相当大的前提啊，Yasu。

lines.en: : Is it truly a caveat if you’re immediately reborn in the process?
lines.zh: : 如果你在过程中能立刻重生，那还算前提吗？

lines.en: : I mean, I’ve definitely got some experience in the “being reborn” department and it’s not all that bad.
lines.zh: : 我说，“重生”这方面我确实有点经验，而且也没那么糟。

lines.en: : But still, yeah.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，是啊。

lines.en: scene churchglow6
: Hahahaha! So it {i}is{/i} true!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！果然“{i}是{/i}”真的！

lines.en: : Every day, you grow some more!
lines.zh: : 每一天，你都在成长！

lines.en: : You’re a truly wonderful person, Sensei. So gifted and handsome and funny.
lines.zh: : 你真是个了不起的人，Sensei。如此天赋异禀、英俊又风趣。

lines.en: : Flattery will get you nowhere, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 奉承可换不来任何东西，Yasu。

lines.en: : Just kidding, it will get you everything you want. Please continue.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的，它能换来你想要的一切。请继续。

lines.en: scene churchglow2
: Perhaps another time.
lines.zh: : 也许改天吧。

lines.en: : For it just occurred to me that I never finished explaining the role of the woman in all of this.
lines.zh: : 因为我突然想起来，我还没讲完女性在这一切中的角色。

lines.en: : You see Sensei, we’re not just entities meant to consume His love and spread His seed.
lines.zh: : 你要明白，Sensei，我们不仅仅是用来领受祂的爱、播撒祂的种子的容器。

lines.en: : We are at first, but not in the end.
lines.zh: : 一开始是，但最终不是。

lines.en: : The truth is, if we work hard enough and make a big enough dent in the armor of older gods, we graduate and become “Angels.”
lines.zh: : 真相是，只要我们足够努力，在古老众神的铠甲上凿出足够大的缺口，我们就能毕业，成为“天使”。

lines.en: : Not angels in the traditional sense with eyes so bright that they could scorch you to death-
lines.zh: : 不是传统意义上那种眼睛亮得能把人烧死的天使——

lines.en: : But angels who decide who stays and who goes.
lines.zh: : 而是决定谁留下、谁离去的天使。

lines.en: : Stays where and goes where?
lines.zh: : 留在哪儿，又去哪儿？

lines.en: : Here and there, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 这里和那里吧，我想。

lines.en: : Informative. And how do you know this if you’re the sole follower of this weird cult thing?
lines.zh: : 真是受益良多。可如果你是这个奇怪邪教唯一的信徒，你又是怎么知道这些的？

lines.en: : Because I can hear it.
lines.zh: : 因为我听得见。

lines.en: : The whispers. The rumbling.
lines.zh: : 那些低语。那些轰鸣。

lines.en: : I can hear it.
lines.zh: : 我听得见。

lines.en: scene churchglow4
: And even if I did not hear those things, I would still know them.
lines.zh: : 就算我没听见那些东西，我也依然知道它们。

lines.en: : There are some things that you don’t need to see or hear in order to understand.
lines.zh: : 有些事，你不需要看见或听见就能明白。

lines.en: scene churchglow7
: How to walk. How to blink. How to breathe.
lines.zh: : 怎么走路。怎么眨眼。怎么呼吸。

lines.en: : Like animals, human beings are born with this wonderful thing called instinct.
lines.zh: : 就像动物一样，人类生来就带着一种奇妙的东西，叫做本能。

lines.en: : We know how to do so many amazing things from the moment we escape our mothers, screaming and dripping with blood.
lines.zh: : 从我们尖叫着、淌着血从母亲体内挣脱出来的那一刻起，我们就懂得做那么多神奇的事。

lines.en: : We don’t know where we are or who we are, but we know we exist.
lines.zh: : 我们不知道自己身在何处、是谁，但我们知道自己存在。

lines.en: : We know that what we see is real and what we feel is real.
lines.zh: : 我们知道自己看见的是真实的，自己感受到的是真实的。

lines.en: : The only thing is, some of us feel a little more than others.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，我们有些人感受得比别人多一点。

lines.en: scene churchglow8
: And some of us {i}see{/i} more than the others.
lines.zh: : 而我们有些人“{i}看见{/i}”得比别人多一点。

lines.en: scene churchglow9
: So...let me just recap a few of the things you’ve said to me over the brief yet incredibly strange time we’ve known each other.
lines.zh: : 那么……让我简单复述一下，在我们相识的这段短暂却极其诡异的时间里，你对我说过的几句话。

lines.en: : Please do~
lines.zh: : 请便~

lines.en: : The first time we met, you talked about how I have “seen God.”
lines.zh: : 我们第一次见面时，你说我“见过神”。

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 我是说过。

lines.en: : Tonight, you are insinuating that I “see more than others.”
lines.zh: : 今晚，你又在暗示我“比别人看得更多”。

lines.en: : Right again.
lines.zh: : 又说对了。

lines.en: : But on like, four other occasions, you have told me I need to open my eyes.
lines.zh: : 可是还有大概四次，你告诉我说我需要睁开眼睛。

lines.en: : Ding ding ding! You remember everything!
lines.zh: : 叮叮叮！你全都记得！

lines.en: : Sorry for just coming out and asking this but...
lines.zh: : 抱歉我这么直接就问了，不过……

lines.en: : Are you on drugs?
lines.zh: : 你在嗑药吗？

lines.en: scene churchglow7
: Not anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在不了。

lines.en: : What do you mean “not anymore?” That seems like a very important detail.
lines.zh: : “现在不了”是什么意思？这听起来像是个很重要的细节。

lines.en: : External forces like medications or narcotics slowly strip the sanity from your mind and your body.
lines.zh: : 药物或麻醉品之类的外力，会慢慢剥走你心智和身体的清明。

lines.en: : I am happier and safer now than I have ever been before.
lines.zh: : 我现在比以往任何时候都更幸福、更安全。

lines.en: : Because now, nothing is held back. Nothing is suppressed.
lines.zh: : 因为现在，什么都没有被压抑。什么都没有被克制。

lines.en: : I can feel His glory and feel His warmth.
lines.zh: : 我能感受到祂的荣光，感受到祂的温暖。

lines.en: : And one day, I hope to feel yours.
lines.zh: : 而有一天，我希望能感受到你的。

lines.en: scene churchglow9
: What a strange way to come out and say that you want to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 想跟我上床，这说法可真够奇怪的。

lines.en: scene churchglow2
: What a strange way to interpret the desire to connect with another human being on a more spiritual level.
lines.zh: : 把“想在更深的灵性层面与另一个人相连”理解成那样，也真够奇怪的。

lines.en: : Warmth does not strictly mean sex, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 温暖并不严格等于性，Sensei。

lines.en: : I feel the warmth of God every day and am very much a virgin.
lines.zh: : 我每天都感受着神的温暖，而我可是个彻头彻尾的处女。

lines.en: : As such, I’d likely be able to feel yours without ever touching you.
lines.zh: : 所以，大概不用碰到你，我也能感受到你的温暖。

lines.en: scene churchglow10
: But, of course, that does not mean we wouldn’t {i}be able{/i} to touch. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 当然，那并不代表我们“{i}不能{/i}”触碰。你明白吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But I’m definitely interested in the touching part.
lines.zh: : 不太明白。不过我对触碰那部分倒确实很有兴趣。

lines.en: : The touching part is a gift from Him and should not be the key interest here.
lines.zh: : 触碰是祂的恩赐，不该是这里的关键兴趣所在。

lines.en: : This is no joke, Sensei. The infusion of righteousness and the transfer of purpose from one body to another is not something that should be taken lightly.
lines.zh: : 这不是玩笑，Sensei。把公义注入、把使命从一个身体转移到另一个身体，不是可以等闲视之的事。

lines.en: : To be pure as judged by the power of Him and Him alone is to rid yourself of love and desire so that he may consume them.
lines.zh: : 在祂、且仅在祂的力量审判下保持纯净，就是要清除自身的爱与欲望，好让祂来吞食它们。

lines.en: : Sex has nothing to do with love. It’s just an action.
lines.zh: : 性和爱毫无关系。它只是一种行为。

lines.en: : An action that must be approved.
lines.zh: : 一种必须被批准的行为。

lines.en: : For we are free to use our bodies to experience {i}that{/i} type of warmth with one another, but only when that warmth flows back into him.
lines.zh: : 因为我们可以自由地用身体去体验“{i}那种{/i}”温暖，但前提是那份温暖要回流进祂里面。

lines.en: : Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 你明白吗？

lines.en: : Again, no.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，不明白。

lines.en: scene churchglow11
: It is He who lives vicariously through our thoughts! Through our sensations!
lines.zh: : 是祂，借由我们的思想和感觉，代我们而活！

lines.en: : Why should {i}we{/i}, as less important, less virtuous creatures, feel the pleasures of life when He can not?!
lines.zh: : 既然祂感受不到，{i}我们{/i}这些更不重要、更不贞洁的造物，凭什么去感受生命的欢愉？！

lines.en: : We must become one with the machinations of this world and all that lives within it so that it may all flow back into Him!
lines.zh: : 我们必须与这个世界的机巧、与其中一切生灵合而为一，好让一切都回流进祂里面！

lines.en: : Each and every ounce of fluid transferred from one entity to the next without His blessing adds more to pain! It makes everything hurt!
lines.zh: : 每一盎司在未经祂祝福的情况下从一个个体转移到另一个个体的体液，都会增添更多的痛苦！它让一切都痛！

lines.en: scene churchglow12
: But when He gives us His blessing, He can feel what we feel.
lines.zh: : 可当祂赐下祝福时，祂就能感受到我们所感受的。

lines.en: : It is all He has. He needs it to survive. He needs it to smile.
lines.zh: : 那是祂仅有的一切。祂需要它才能存活。祂需要它才能微笑。

lines.en: : And when He smiles, we smile. I smile.
lines.zh: : 而祂微笑时，我们便微笑。我便微笑。

lines.en: : Smile with me, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 跟我一起微笑吧，Sensei！

lines.en: : I’m okay, thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: scene churchglow2
: The act of human beings connecting on a physical level should be something witnessed before Him.
lines.zh: : 人类在肉体层面相连的行为，本该在祂面前进行。

lines.en: : As an angel in training, it is my duty to abstain from any practice He would find abhorrent.
lines.zh: : 作为见习天使，我有义务戒除一切祂会觉得可憎的行为。

lines.en: : It is my duty to forego the realm of the senses so that each and every sensation can be used on someone much bigger than me.
lines.zh: : 我有义务放弃感官的领域，好让每一种感觉都能用在某个比我伟大得多的存在身上。

lines.en: : I am a tiny girl, and yet this body feels so much.
lines.zh: : 我只是个小小的女孩，可这具身体却感受得如此之多。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how He, who encompasses all space, must feel.
lines.zh: : 我只能想象，无所不包的祂，感受又会是怎样的。

lines.en: scene churchglow13
: Sing me a song that reminds me of better days!
lines.zh: : 给我唱一首让我想起美好岁月的歌吧！

lines.en: : Enter me and experience all that I am!
lines.zh: : 进入我，体验我的一切！

lines.en: : Consume my thoughts and wrap yourself around my organs!
lines.zh: : 吞下我的思想，缠绕上我的脏器！

lines.en: : Bask in the warmth that you have sacrificed so that we may live!
lines.zh: : 沐浴在你为让我们活下去而献出的温暖里吧！

lines.en: : When all others fail you, I will still be here! Feel it all through me!
lines.zh: : 当所有人都背弃你时，我依然会在这里！透过我感受一切吧！

lines.en: : Feel everything through me! For I am yours and yours alone!
lines.zh: : 透过我感受一切吧！因为我属于你，只属于你！

lines.en: : Praise be!
lines.zh: : 赞美主！

lines.en: scene churchglow14
: He’s feeling shy tonight and doesn’t want to talk to me.
lines.zh: : 祂今晚害羞了，不想跟我说话。

lines.en: : Probably because you’re here.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你在这儿。

lines.en: : But that’s okay. He is all powerful, but can act a little childish at times.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。祂全能，但有时候会有点孩子气。

lines.en: : He’s still very young, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 总的来说，祂还很年轻。

lines.en: : Okay, well I think that’s enough for tonight.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想今晚就到这里吧。

lines.en: : Will you come back?
lines.zh: : 你还会来吗？

lines.en: : Probably. But not because I believe in your god.
lines.zh: : 大概会。但不是因为我相信你的神。

lines.en: : Because I “entertain” you?
lines.zh: : 因为我“让你觉得有趣”？

lines.en: : Because you “entertain” me.
lines.zh: : 因为你“让我觉得有趣”。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Yasu。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: : May the path you walk be free of callousness.
lines.zh: : 愿你行走的路上没有冷酷。

lines.en: scene black
I exit the church and walk out into the snow.
lines.zh: 我走出教堂，迈入雪中。

lines.en: It’s somehow even warmer out here than it was in there.
lines.zh: 外面不知怎么比里面还暖和。

lines.en: I go home.
lines.zh: 我回家了。
